title: Packages and repositories
description: What to install, from where, and which service unit results, for each operating system family the profile supports. Native packages from vendor repositories only: nothing here describes a source build or a tarball unpacked into /opt.

families.description: Keyed by operating system family. Every family declared in profile.yml needs an entry here, which the loader checks: a profile that claims a family it cannot install on is worse than one that does not claim it.

items.description: A package name, which may reference the version placeholder.

service.description: The service unit that results, which may reference the version and instance placeholders.

url.description: Plain HTTP is not offered. A package repository reached without transport security is a supply chain nobody controls.

key_url.description: Where the signing key comes from.

suite.description: The distribution or release the repository is keyed by, where the family uses one.

gpg_check.description: Absent means true. Setting it to false is a decision that has to survive a code review.
